
=== WebPanel: Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladora ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&IsAuthorized_ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin = WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusoramezcladoraview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Extrusora Mezcladora'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ExtrusoraNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	WWPBaseObjects.ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraNombre'
					&TFExtrusoraNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin'
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax'
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin'
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax'
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen'
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido'
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Display = "GXM_display"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Display)
		&Display.Link = gestionarExtrusoraMezcladora.Link(TrnMode.Display, ExtrusoraMezcladoraId)
	Endif
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = gestionarExtrusoraMezcladora.Link(TrnMode.Update, ExtrusoraMezcladoraId)
	Endif
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = gestionarExtrusoraMezcladora.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ExtrusoraMezcladoraId)
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin)
		ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.Link = ExtrusoraMezcladoraView.Link(ExtrusoraMezcladoraId, '')
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DocmdAgregar' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_cmdAgregar)
		gestionarExtrusoraMezcladora.Call(TrnMode.Insert, &ExtrusoraMezcladoraId)
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Transaction: DB.ExtrusoraMezcladora ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusoraId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusoraId"
					&Insert_ExtrusoraId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPBaseObjects.AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		ExtrusoraMezcladoraWW.Call()
	Endif
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ExtrusoraMezcladoraId);

ExtrusoraMezcladoraId = &ExtrusoraMezcladoraId if not &ExtrusoraMezcladoraId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ExtrusoraMezcladoraId);
noprompt(ExtrusoraMezcladoraId);

ExtrusoraId = &Insert_ExtrusoraId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ExtrusoraId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ExtrusoraId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ExtrusoraId.IsEmpty();
}

LoadAuditExtrusoraMezcladora.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ExtrusoraMezcladoraId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditExtrusoraMezcladora.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ExtrusoraMezcladoraId, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditExtrusoraMezcladora.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ExtrusoraMezcladoraId, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditExtrusoraMezcladora.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ExtrusoraMezcladoraId, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraView ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	WorkWithLink.Link = DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWW.Link()
	For each ExtrusoraMezcladora
		where ExtrusoraMezcladoraId = &ExtrusoraMezcladoraId
		Form.Caption = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.ToString()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "WWP_RecordNotFound"
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	If (&Exists)
		Do 'LoadTabs'
	Endif
	&RecordDescription = Form.Caption
	If &Session.Get(!'DiscussionThreadIdToOpen') <> ''
		ddc_Discussions.Open()
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If Not WWP_HasDiscussionMessages(!'ExtrusoraMezcladora', ExtrusoraMezcladoraId.ToString().Trim())
		ddc_Discussions.Icon = "far fa-comment"
	EndIf
	If (WWP_HasSubscriptionsToDisplay(!'ExtrusoraMezcladora', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.SpecificRecord))
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = True
	Else
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = False
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddc_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'ExtrusoraMezcladora', WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.SpecificRecord, ExtrusoraMezcladoraId.ToString().Trim(), &RecordDescription)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddc_Discussions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_DiscussionsWC.Create(!'ExtrusoraMezcladora', ExtrusoraMezcladoraId.ToString().Trim(), &RecordDescription, DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraView.Link(ExtrusoraMezcladoraId, ''))
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

parm(in:&ExtrusoraMezcladoraId, in:&TabCode);

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== WebPanel: Produccion.gestionarExtrusoraMezcladora ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&AuditTableName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladora'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusoramezcladora_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusoramezcladora_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'extrusoramezcladora_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&ExtrusoraMezcladora.Load(&ExtrusoraMezcladoraId)
			&LoadSuccess = &ExtrusoraMezcladora.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &ExtrusoraMezcladora.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				ExtrusoraMezcladora_ExtrusoraId.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraMezcladora_ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraMezcladora_ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraMezcladora_ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraMezcladora_ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraMezcladora_ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.Enabled = False
				ExtrusoraMezcladora_ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Do 'AttributesSecurityCode'
	ExtrusoraMezcladora_ExtrusoraMezcladoraId.Visible = False
	wcAuditoria.Object = AuditHistoryById.Create(&AuditTableName, &ExtrusoraMezcladoraId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&ExtrusoraMezcladora.Delete()
			Else
				&ExtrusoraMezcladora.Save()
			EndIf
			If &ExtrusoraMezcladora.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &ExtrusoraMezcladora.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
parm(in:&TrnMode, in:&ExtrusoraMezcladoraId);
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Extrusora")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Extrusora")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Virgen Min")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Virgen Max")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Molido Min")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Molido Max")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Kg Virgen")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Kg Molido")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.ExtrusoraMezcladora
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ExtrusoraNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraNombre", '', !'Extrusora', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin", '', !'Virgen Min', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax", '', !'Virgen Max', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin", '', !'Molido Min', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax", '', !'Molido Max', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen", '', !'Kg Virgen', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido", '', !'Kg Molido', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGVIRGEN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGMOLIDO"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'listarextrusoramezcladora_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Extrusora Mezcladora List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFExtrusoraNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Virgen Min", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Virgen Max", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Molido Min", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Molido Max", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Kg Virgen", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Kg Molido", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.ExtrusoraMezcladora
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order GeneXusSecurity.ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(WWPBaseObjects.LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraGridState"))

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGVIRGEN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGMOLIDO"

				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

=== Procedure: Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraGetFilterData ===

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSORANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadExtrusoraNombreOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

Sub 'LoadExtrusoraNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusoraNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.ExtrusoraMezcladora
		Order ExtrusoraId
		using Produccion.ListarExtrusoraMezcladoraDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraNombre, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.ExtrusoraMezcladora
			Order ExtrusoraId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusoraNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

parm(in:&DDOName, in:&SearchTxt, in:&SearchTxtTo, out:&OptionsJson, out:&OptionsDescJson, out:&OptionIndexesJson);

					&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.ExtrusoraMezcladora.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ExtrusoraMezcladoraId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'

Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each ExtrusoraMezcladora
		Where ExtrusoraMezcladoraId = &ExtrusoraMezcladoraId
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladora'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Mezcladora Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ExtrusoraMezcladoraId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Extrusora Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ExtrusoraId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraNombre'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Extrusora'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each ExtrusoraMezcladora
		Where ExtrusoraMezcladoraId = &ExtrusoraMezcladoraId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladora'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusoraMezcladoraId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Molido Max'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Kg Virgen'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusoraId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraNombre'

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Mezcladora Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraId.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraId_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Extrusora Id")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraId
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Extrusora")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Extrusora")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFExtrusoraNombre)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Virgen Min")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Virgen Max")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Molido Min")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Molido Max")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Kg Virgen")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Kg Molido")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.ExtrusoraMezcladora
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraId  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraId)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraNombre  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To, &TFExtrusoraId, &TFExtrusoraId_To, &TFExtrusoraNombre
					, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraId'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraId
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraNombre'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(ExtrusoraNombre)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)

	EndIf

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraId", '', !'Mezcladora Id', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraId", '', !'Extrusora Id', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraNombre", '', !'Extrusora', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin", '', !'Virgen Min', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax", '', !'Virgen Max', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin", '', !'Molido Min', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax", '', !'Molido Max', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen", '', !'Kg Virgen', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido", '', !'Kg Molido', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAID"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAID"
				&TFExtrusoraId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGVIRGEN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGMOLIDO"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.

		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer

Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraId
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Mezcladora Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraId.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraId_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraId
		&TFExtrusoraId_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Extrusora Id", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraId_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFExtrusoraNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Virgen Min", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Virgen Max", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Molido Min", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Molido Max", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.IsEmpty() AND &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Kg Virgen", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To
	EndIf

		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
		&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Kg Molido", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each ExtrusoraMezcladora
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraId  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraId)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraId  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraId)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraNombre  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To, &TFExtrusoraId, &TFExtrusoraId_To, &TFExtrusoraNombre
					, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAID"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAID"
				&TFExtrusoraId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGVIRGEN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGMOLIDO"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()

	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSORANOMBRE'

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAID"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAID"
				&TFExtrusoraId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOVIRGENMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMIN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAHUSILLOMOLIDOMAX"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGVIRGEN"
				&TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSORAMEZCLADORAKGMOLIDO"

Sub 'LoadExtrusoraNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusoraNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each ExtrusoraMezcladora
		Order ExtrusoraId
		using ExtrusoraMezcladoraWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraId_To, &TFExtrusoraId, &TFExtrusoraId_To, &TFExtrusoraNombre
					, &TFExtrusoraNombre_Sel, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloVirgenMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMin_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraHusilloMolidoMax_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgVirgen_To, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido
					, &TFExtrusoraMezcladoraKgMolido_To)

		&count = 0
		For Each ExtrusoraMezcladora
			Order ExtrusoraId
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusoraNombre
			
			&InsertIndex = 1
			Do while &InsertIndex <= &Options.Count AND &Options.Item(&InsertIndex) < &Option
				&InsertIndex = &InsertIndex + 1
			EndDo
			&Options.Add(&Option, &InsertIndex)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()), &InsertIndex)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

parm(in:&DDOName, in:&SearchTxt, in:&SearchTxtTo, out:&OptionsJson, out:&OptionsDescJson, out:&OptionIndexesJson);
